title: finance-budget-q2-1on1-prep-ethan
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep with Priya (Finance Lead) - Q2 run-rate review / procurement approvals
Date: 2026-03-04
Purpose: Quick sync to align on Q2 run-rate assumptions, flag procurement approvals needed before month-end, and confirm contingency plan if spend creeps.

Agenda (15-20 min)
- Quick run-rate recap (2-3 min)
  - Current monthly run-rate (Feb actual): $1,180,000
  - Feb -> Mar projected increase (hiring + infra ramp): +$60k/mo -> projected Mar run-rate $1,240,000
  - Q2 baseline assumption used in forecast: $1.25M/mo (conservative)
- Key variances YTD (3-4 min)
  - Infra (hosting + Dedicated infra) overrun: +$35k vs plan (due to early Dedicated rollout testing)
  - Contractor spend (SWE + DS contractors): +$18k vs plan; ramped for inference performance work
  - Sales incentives accrual timing pushed to Apr -> temporary favorable variance in Mar, flip in Apr
- Procurement approvals pending (5 min)
  1) Hardware purchase: 4x A100-equivalent instances for private PoC (estimated capex $240k)
     - Current ask: approve PO up to $250k to include cabling/warranty
     - Rationale: needed to meet Private deployment pilot SLAs and avoid delayed customer milestones
     - Risk: if delayed beyond Apr, we may miss two pilot go-lives (~$120k ARR impact)
  2) Monitoring/observability SaaS renewal: 12-month renewal for high-retention logs (~$48k)
     - Ask: approve early renewal to lock current pricing and avoid 15% inflation
  3) Dedicated capacity overcommit buffer: temporary top-up to cover Q2 artifacts ($40k prepaid)
     - Ask: approve reclass from Opex to committed spend (accounting preference)
- Decisions needed (2 min)
  - Approve hardware PO up to $250k? (yes/no)
  - Approve observability renewal now to avoid price increase? (yes/no)
  - Confirm policy for reclassifying prepaid Dedicated buffer (accounting + legal ok?)
- Next steps & owners (2-3 min)
  - If approved, procurement draft PO (Marco) -> finalize and send by 2026-03-10
  - Finance to model cashflow impact on Mar monthly close (Ethan)
  - Update Q2 forecast variant (Priya) to include two scenarios: conservative (no hardware spend) and base (hardware + renewals)

Notes / Talking points to surface
- We are still within runway assumptions for Series C plan, but Q2 hardware + contractor ramp shifts cash runway by ~6-8 weeks if not offset by bookings (call out explicitly).
- Emphasize customer timing: pilot go-live windows tied to hardware arrive by mid-April; pushing hardware buys risks churn on two pilot accounts.
- Observability vendor: current vendor provided a 1-week window for locked pricing; delaying approval will trigger +15% renewal. Avoid partial-year proration complexities.
- Suggest contingency: if board prefers capex hold, propose leasing option with 12-mo term (~$28k/mo) - keeps pilots on schedule but increases monthly Opex.

Open questions to resolve in meeting
- Priya: Are we comfortable moving $250k to capex this quarter vs deferring to next?
- Legal: any red flags on early renewal term length for observability? (Marco to confirm)
- Accounting: confirm reclass treatment for Dedicated prepaid buffer (Jordan)

Action items (post-meeting)
- Ethan: run cash-flow sensitivity for Q2 scenarios (due 2026-03-06)
- Marco: prepare supplier PO draft and hardware vendor T&Cs (due 2026-03-09)
- Priya: update Q2 forecast sheet with base/conservative scenarios and circulate to execs (due 2026-03-07)
- Jordan: check accounting treatment and confirm reclass path (due 2026-03-05)

Quick wins to propose if approvals delayed
- Request vendor expedite partial shipment (2 nodes) to unblock 1 pilot - reduces immediate capex need
- Negotiate 30-day hold on observability pricing while we finalize approval (gives breathing room)

Scratch notes (for my memory)
- If board asks: show ARR impact table + runway delta + mitigations (leasing, pausing contractor ramp)
- Keep minimal ask: prefer single-ask approval (hardware + observability) to simplify decisioning in 1:1
- Bring printout of forecast sensitivity (2 slides)

References
- Q2 forecast sheet tab: "Run-Rate Sensitivity" (link in linked_artifacts)
- Vendor quote ID: HW-QUOTE-2026-02-17 (attach to PO draft)

End of notes.
